name: The Standing Racks
flavor: Two racks still drawing power out of the sand, and a shape between them made of more people than it should be.

scanHints.text: The racks are immune to Kinetic. The Echo is immune to everything but Chronal.
Wren: there are four hundred people in that outline and they are all carrying the same thing.
Your own Entropy is high enough to add to their number.
